item.title: i-DSCS
item.description: The i-DSCS and DSCS use the same option line settings for L9.

item.title: DSCS
item.description: Mechanism The DSCS encoder measures the actual length of yarn used and compares it with the theoretical length of yarn used.

item.title: MACH2X for Shima Seiki Shaping Machine Users
item.description: These are (informal) notes about the Shima Seiki MACH2X M173X15L knitting machine (15 gauge, large hook needles, 1.7m wide needle bed).

item.title: Automatic Software
item.description: The SUTD researchers call this New File Format too. If I remember correctly, Shima Seiki calls it automatic software.

item.title: Package Pattern Gather Up
item.description: This function is used to retrieve package base patterns from Shima Seiki’s database.

item.title: Comb
item.description: The comb force is specified in kg. The comb force is scaled to the width of the knitted fabric.

item.title: Pulldown Device
item.description: The pulldown device (PDD) is a claw-like device that pulls on the knitted fabric to provide takedown force.

item.title: Front Body Back Body
item.description: If you want more freedom to specify different knit structures on the front face and back face of the fabric, you can create 3 compressed patterns.

item.title: About
item.description: PZ: These are notes based on personal experience with a Shima Seiki MACH2XS153-15L and MACH2X M173X15L, and passing experience with shaping machines (SVR123SP, SES122S, SCG122SN), a Mini machine (SWG091N2), and a Kniterate.
